shots.name: demo-game
shots.about: BagiDemo in Game mode after one second: the scene, with the fountain running

shots.name: demo-editor
shots.about: BagiDemo in the editor, Scene Editor tab in front and the Root node open (two clicks at fixed points of the 1600x900 layout): hierarchy, viewport, sprite library

shots.name: first-scene
shots.about: BagiDemo on the finished scene of the first-scene page (docs/guide/examples/first-scene): sky, title and the gem

shots.name: ui-screen
shots.about: BagiDemo on the example screen of the ui-screen page (docs/guide/examples/ui-screen) in a desktop window: the settings plate in its landscape form

shots.name: ui-screen-phone
shots.about: the same screen in a portrait window: the Language row has its caption above the buttons (the portrait variant of the sheet)

shots.name: prefab
shots.about: BagiDemo on the example of the prefab page (docs/guide/examples/prefab): three instances of one node file, each with its own text, and the third in another colour

shots.name: tween-start
shots.about: BagiDemo on the example of the tween page (docs/guide/examples/tween) at frame 5: the star (slider) and the arrow (turner) have just started their first leg, and the gem (bobber) is still waiting out its delay

shots.name: tween-far
shots.about: the same scene at frame 126, two seconds after the runs started: the slider is at the far end of its way and the turner at 180 degrees, the bobber is half way back

shots.name: input-before
shots.about: BagiDemo on the example of the input page (docs/guide/examples/input-actions) at frame 5: the title and the round pad, no sparks yet

shots.name: input-clicked
shots.about: the same scene 40 frames after a click_at on the middle of the pad: the Pop action has made the burst, the sparks fly out of the pad

shots.name: reflection-inspector
shots.about: BagiDemo in the editor on the tween example, the Slider node selected (four clicks at fixed points of the 1600x900 layout): the inspector shows the fields of its DemoTweenComponent

shots.name: editor-console
shots.about: The Console opened with Ctrl+Shift+L over the editor: the filter field holds Control so two log lines are left, and the command line has answered ping and status
